content_sections.heading: How Will JUIDCO Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Merit basis on the percentage of marks obtained in Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineer/B.Com/B.A./B.Sc. Merit on percentage of marks in the qualifying Degree/Diploma Selected candidates are called for verification of certificates

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Matriculation Certificate & Mark Sheet and Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineer/B.Com/B.A./B.Sc Certificate & Mark sheet Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC (NCL) only) and Certificate for EWS candidates Medical Certificate for physically handicapped only Photo and signature Aadhaar Card and Aadhaar card linked bank account APAAR ID

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JUIDCO Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the Govt. portal https://nats.education.gov.in and click on the Registration Tab to register for Apprenticeship Training. Click the activation link in the confirmation e-mail sent to the registered e-mail address. Login and complete the profile to confirm the registration. Upload the required documents; illegible documents lead to rejection. Click on the Apprenticeship Opportunities Tab and select the desired trade. Select only one unit, JUIDCO Ltd, on or before 13-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA or accommodation for verification of certificates or for coming to the place of training Management reserves the right to reject applications without reason and raise standards to restrict numbers Candidature liable for rejection at any stage for suppression/furnishing of false information Result will be published on juidco.jharkhand.gov.in Selected candidates will be informed through their registered email ID Applications received after 13-11-2026 shall not be considered

faq.answer: Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineer, B.Com, or B.A/B.Sc, passed out during 2022 to 2026; only candidates holding the mark sheet/certificate can apply. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Must have passed out during the period from 2022 to 2026. Registration on the NATS portal is required.

faq.answer: Candidates awaiting their mark sheet/certificates. Candidates who previously completed or underwent apprenticeship training under NATS. Candidates currently undergoing NATS training. Candidates who discontinued their NATS training midway.
